name: @freetesh/canon
description: canon CLI: keep your domain knowledge and AI rules in your repo, and enforce them.
author: Ritesh Firodiya

scripts.check: node cli/src/index.ts check . && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test
scripts.build: rm -rf cli/dist && tsc -p cli/tsconfig.build.json && pnpm bundle
scripts.test:band: d=$(mktemp -d) && mkdir -p $d/cli/src && cp -R hooks .claude-plugin $d && mkdir -p $d/cli/src/setup && cp -R cli/src/setup/models $d/cli/src/setup && claude plugin test $d
scripts.bundle: esbuild cli/src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node22 --log-level=warning --outfile=bin/canon --banner:js='import { createRequire as canonRequire } from "node:module"; const require = canonRequire(import.meta.url);' && chmod +x bin/canon
